title: On the emulated A1200 IDE port the last 144 sectors of the world partition AW_WORLD0 were unreadable, so loading Khuul stopped the game
status: First seen 2026-11-03 17:27 +0200 / 2026-11-03 15:27 UTC, three times by 2026-11-03 17:43 +0200 / 2026-11-03 15:43 UTC: the v0.0.59-dev6 delivery hops stopped on the teleport from Ald'ruhn to Khuul, waiting on a DOS request held by DW0. Cause: the IDE port reads a drive as whole cylinders of 16 heads x 63 sectors; the dev6 drive (6,266,944 sectors) read as 6,266,736, and AW_WORLD0 ends at 6,266,880, so Khuul's files lay past the end and Kickstart's read error requester (block 2480045) waited hidden behind the game. The hard-file device sees the whole file, so earlier deliveries passed; the test sessions had moved to IDE that morning. Found by A/B: Khuul first, the dev5 engine and the dev5 image on IDE all stopped; the hard-file device and a padded copy passed. Fixed in v0.0.59-dev6 (b05f9f32, ad3c345e, gate 6660): every drive padded with zeros to whole IDE cylinders right after it is written, and the build gate require_ide_cylinders stops a build with a drive that is not whole cylinders or a partition past the last one (tests/test_ide_cylinders.py). The same rule at plan time, in the master builder, in every image path and in the release guard follows.
where: tools/world_volumes.py assemble_drives: the drive size against IDE cylinders
severity_reason: The game stops for good on an IDE setup when it reads a file in the drive's last part (Khuul); every IDE user was exposed.

title: Residents' recipe table held for the whole island instead of per cell and room
status: Decided for the project, 3 November 2026: one small binary recipe table per place, holding only the residents placed there (42 bytes a resident: id hash, race and sex, head, hair and worn items as indices into the table's own names). The exterior cells' tables are in one pack, view/npc_parts/cells.awnp, whose index is read once; a cell's table is read with one seek and one read when the streamer's window joins the cell. A room's table, view/npc_parts/<map>.awnb, is read on entering the room. Tables of places just left stay in a small cache, and a resident directory (dir.awnd) lets a resident outside the loaded places read only its own place's table. Lookups compare id hashes; nothing island-wide is written or searched. Supersedes the image-step merge of BUILD-NPC-RECIPES-COLLIDE-59.
where: tools/npc_recipes.py, engine/aga/src/aw_npc_parts.c (view/npc_parts.txt)
severity_reason: One recipe file for every resident, read at each lookup: not loaded per place like the residents themselves.
